Free calculators

Australian tax calculators

Every tool here is free, ungated and current for 2026-27, 2025-26 and 2024-25. They share one tax engine, so two calculators can never give you different answers to the same question.

  • Start here

    Income tax

    Your tax, Medicare levy, study loan repayment and take-home pay for any income, in any of the last three financial years.

    Open calculator

  • Start here

    Tax refund

    Estimate your refund by adding the deductions you actually have. Watch the number move as you claim.

    Open calculator

The rest of the suite

  • Capital gains

    What you will pay on a share, property or crypto sale — with the 50% discount and any carried-forward losses applied in the right order.

  • HECS-HELP

    Your compulsory repayment under the marginal system that replaced the old flat rates on 1 July 2025.

  • PAYG withholding

    How much tax should come out of each pay — weekly, fortnightly or monthly — and whether your employer has it right.

  • Medicare levy

    The 2% levy, the low-income reduction that shades it in, and whether the surcharge applies to you.

  • Sole trader

    Tax on your business profit, plus what to put aside for GST and the next PAYG instalment.

  • Crypto

    Crypto disposals are CGT events. Work out the gain, the discount you qualify for and the tax on it.

  • Rental property

    Rental income less expenses and depreciation, and what the result does to your tax — negative or positive.

  • Salary sacrifice

    What sacrificing into super costs you in take-home pay, and what it saves you in tax.

  • GST

    Add or remove GST, and see the GST-exclusive figure your BAS actually wants.

One engine behind all of them

The brackets, the Medicare levy with its low-income shading, the marginal study loan scale, the low income tax offset and the s 25-130 standard deduction are implemented once, in versioned rate files that each cite their ATO source and the date they were checked. Every calculator on this page calls the same functions.

That matters more than it sounds. Most tax calculators on the web reimplement the scale per page, which is why the same income can produce three different answers on the same site. Ours cannot: the arithmetic runs in one place and is tested at every bracket boundary.

Want the underlying figures rather than a calculator? The tax rates page has the full bracket tables for all three years, and the guides explain what you can actually claim.

Ready to lodge it?

A registered agent prepares it, checks it, and lodges it.

Most refunds land within two weeks of assessment. The fee is fixed and quoted before we start — nothing is charged until you approve the finished return.
